evidence: https://musicbrainz.org/artist/83f6e15e-f4bf-458f-9ebf-4d2634f92dd8 : Inside, group, Lindenhurst NY, "US 90s emo", active 1995-08 to 1999 = the artist:inside of the cache (Long Island emo band, 1995-1999)

MusicBrainz lists exactly 3 release groups for that artist, the earliest from 1997: no "The EP"; a search for a release group "The EP" by Inside returns 0 results, and so does a search for the recording "Music For Windows"

The work is a 1993 vinyl EP (Happy Music, tracks Music For Windows / Wonderfull / Wears Harvey, written and produced by Kurt Howes and Merlin; Discogs release 966968), two years before the band existed

MusicBrainz has other Inside: 17cccfd9-d8f6-4af8-a1e4-9c149a278217 (group, "ebm", 1996-2003) and Fluffy Inside 7e248f92-e266-4a91-95aa-828f7e7d3dc8 (UK electronic musician): the namesakes the false credit came from
The cache's own citations tell them apart: artist:inside cites Discogs artist 1352496 "Inside (9)", the work cites a release by the unnumbered "Inside"
